name: button-group
title: Button Group
description: Joins buttons, inputs and text into one control with shared borders, laid out horizontally or vertically.
notes: Use orientation="vertical" to stack. Nest ButtonGroups to put gaps between sets.
Filled buttons have no border, so put a ButtonGroupSeparator between them, as in the split button. Give the group an aria-label when its purpose is not clear from the buttons.
